name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
summary: Working-capital loan of up to ₹10,000 for street vendors, with interest subsidy.
description: Micro-credit facility that gives street vendors affordable working-capital loans.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
implementingAuthority: Urban Local Bodies and lending institutions
targetBeneficiaries: Street vendors / hawkers in urban areas

evidence.quote: Street vendors/ hawkers vending in urban areas, as on or before March 24, 2020, including the vendors of surrounding peri-urban and rural areas.

criteria.label: Vending in urban areas on or before 24 March 2020 (or holding a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB/TVC)

evidence.quote: Street vendors/ hawkers vending in urban areas, as on or before March 24, 2020

benefits.text: Initial working-capital loan of up to Rs 10,000 for one year, 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment, and cash-back on digital transactions.

evidence.quote: The Initial working capital loan is upto `10,000/- for a tenure of one year.

applicationProcess: Apply online on the PM SVANidhi portal or through a Banking Correspondent / MFI agent.
